column5: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Hunger gnaws at you. Like Storihbeg, shape it into a brutal weapon. Gain the ability to devour corpses, for up to 4 seconds per corpse. Each second devouring you heal for 3200 Health , based off your Max Health , and restore 15 Ultimate . If you are a Werewolf Berserker, each tick activates Fury generation.
WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Give chase, hunter. Become pursuit unrelenting. Increases your Movement Speed by 15 %.

column5: WHILE YOU ARE IN WEREWOLF FORM Honor your pact and let loose your rage. Increases the amount of Fury you generate by 5 . Fury is generated by using Werewolf abilities while in combat. column5: The Great Hunt demands more participants. Become a shepard to the lamb who wishes to fight back. Allows you to infect another player with Lycanthropy once every week by returning to the Werewolf ritual site. Players already infected with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria cannot be infected with Lycanthropy.
